title: Intrinsic linking of simplicial $n$-complexes in $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$: An additional minimal $n$-complex
summary: For any positive integer $n$, the author previously constructed several minimal simplicial $n$-complexes which necessarily contain a non-splittable two-component link, consisting of an $(n-1)$-sphere and an $n$-sphere, in any embedding into $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$. In this paper, we present an additional simplicial $n$-complex with the same property.
